A rejected turn must never show the previous turn's narration as its own capture reply.
Read the existing tests, `storygame/runtime/hedged_request.py` and how the game dispatches hedged requests (grep for HedgedResult and Attempt) so you understand which fields exist. The recorder cannot see the game's logical request id; do not invent one: use the owner stamp plus the typed `hedge_fired` and winner information only if the HTTP layer can see them, otherwise omit them and say so.
